fullPassage: Participants in a study were asked to answer questions like "Why does the moon have phases?" Half the participants were told to search for the answers on the internet, while the other half weren't allowed to do so. Then, in the second part of the study, all of the participants were presented with a new set of questions, such as "Why does Swiss cheese have holes?" These questions were unrelated to the ones asked during the first part of the study, so participants who used the internet had absolutely no advantage over those who hadn't. You would think that both sets of participants would be equally sure or unsure about how well they could answer the new questions. But those who used the internet in the first part of the study rated themselves as more knowledgeable than those who hadn't, even about questions they hadn't searched online for. The study suggests that having access to unrelated information was enough to pump up their intellectual confidence.

Then, in the second part of the study, all of the participants were ②<u>presented</u> with a new set of questions, such as "Why does Swiss cheese have holes?" These questions were unrelated to the ones asked during the first part of the study, so participants who ③<u>used</u> the internet had absolutely no advantage over those who hadn't. You would think that both sets of participants would be equally sure or unsure about how well they could answer the new questions. But those who used the internet in the first part of the study rated themselves as more knowledgeable than those who hadn't, even about questions they hadn't searched online for. The study suggests that ④<u>having</u> access to unrelated information was enough to pump up their intellectual confidence.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
정답 ①: 'Participants in a study were __________ to answer questions'에서 be동사(were) 뒤에는 수동을 나타내는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 ask가 아니라 asked가 맞다. (원문: asked)

② presented: were presented(수동태 과거분사) — 적절

③ used: 관계절 who used(과거 정동사) — 적절

④ having: 문장의 주어로 쓰인 동명사 — 적절
det.tip: be동사(were) 뒤에서 수동을 나타낼 때는 동사원형이 아니라 과거분사(asked)를 씁니다.

det.analysis: 과거완료(had + p.p.) 전환: 'they hadn't __________'는 hadn't(=had not) 뒤에 과거분사가 오는 과거완료 자리이므로 동사 search를 과거분사 searched로 바꾼다. '검색하지 않았던'이라는 뜻이 된다.

다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]에 맞게 빈칸을 (영어로) 쓰시오.

인터넷에서 그 답들을 검색하다
[조건] (1) answers, for, internet, on, search, the, the 를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.analysis: 동사구 어순: '검색하다'는 search for(~을 찾다)이고, 목적어 the answers가 뒤에 온다 → search for the answers. '인터넷에서'는 on the internet으로 뒤에 붙인다. 순서: search for → the answers → on the internet. the가 두 번(the answers / the internet) 쓰인다.
det.tip: '~을 검색하다'는 search for, '인터넷에서'는 on the internet입니다. the가 두 번 필요합니다.
